'''Uden Fen''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Zoge Ver]] and [[Renenen]] in the [[Guter Wade system]]. It held the third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Rek (star)|Rek]] in the [[Trilon sector/Legends|Trilon sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].
